pos.name: Verb
etymology: Inherited from Proto-Vietic *-saː, cognate with Tho [Cuối Chăm] saː¹ and Muong tha.

gloss: to be released, to be published, to be out, to come out

examples.en: Hey, this movie has just came out.
He didn't turn out to be anybody.

usage_notes: (“to go”) is used for emphasis when appended to ra, forming
to mean "go even further out". However, this usage may vary from dialect to dialect.
Ra is used after an adjective to indicate a positive development of a character or state of a person or thing.

usage_notes.vi: Cô ấy dạo này trẻ ra.

usage_notes: ― She is getting younger these days.

gloss: very (placed before the word to intensify)

usage_notes: In colloquial Vietnamese, there are many compounds of intensified adjectives which in many situations are preferred over the constructions of adjective + intensifier or intensifier + adjective. Examples such as
(along with many others) are used extensively.
The usage of rất is quite restricted in colloquial Vietnamese and it most often occurs within compounds with
. Generally, Vietnamese speakers prefer adjective + intensifier constructions in casual situations.

usage_notes.vi: Trời thì rất chi là nóng mà còn bận áo dài tay nữa hử?

usage_notes: ― It's stupidly hot and you're really out here wearing a long-sleeved shirt, huh?

examples.vi: Tôi tin rằng anh ấy sẽ thực hiện đúng lời hứa.
examples.en: I believe that he will keep his promise.

gloss: last (week, year, etc.); that just passed
acknowledges an item in a list of requests, such as when taking an order

examples.vi: Thằng cha này cũng ra gì phết đấy chứ.
examples.en: Such a boy of class, isn't he?

gloss: to act, to perform an action

examples.vi: Giờ chưa phải lúc ta ra mặt.
Hệ thống thanh tra thương mại từ trung ương đến tỉnh, thành phố và quận, huyện, thị xã ra sao?
examples.en: How is the commercial inspection system from the central government to the province, city, and district?

gloss: to make a gesture; to signal
to go outside the class to play during recess

examples.vi: Sao ngồi tù lù đó? Không ra chơi à?
examples.en: Why're you sitting forlorn there? Why not going out?

examples.vi: Điều đó thì tôi không rõ lắm.
examples.en: I am not very clear on that.

gloss: to be born; to come into the world
to come into being; to arise
having lots of space, or spanning across great amounts of space; spacious, wide, broad, vast, large, etc.
having great breadth or depth; broad, vast, great, deep, etc.
to present oneself (in front of others); to come into sight
to bring about some significant result

examples.vi: Đã làm thì phải làm cho ra trò chứ.
examples.en: There should be at least a payoff afterwards once we've kicked in.

gloss: to leave; to get out (from); to take out (from); to get away; to break loose

examples.vi: Mỹ đã không đạt được những mục tiêu quân sự cụ thể vì chế độ Xát-đam Hút-xen đã đẩy Mỹ ra khỏi phía bắc Irắc.
examples.en: The U.S. was unable to attain its military objectives in full because the Saddam Hussein regime forced the U.S. to leave northern Iraq.

examples.vi: Làm sao mang bức tranh này ra khỏi phi trường được.
examples.en: There's no way I can take this painting out of the airport.

gloss: as to; as regards; except for
to issue a command; to order (esp. in a stately manner)

examples.vi: Chủ tịch tỉnh ra lệnh sơ tán.
examples.en: The provincial president issued an evacuation order.

examples.vi: Nó quát tháo nhặng xị như ông quan hách dịch nào đó ngày xưa ra lệnh cho dân.
examples.en: He loudly barked out orders as if he's a big shot from the days of yore giving orders to the lowly commoners.

etymology: From Proto-Vietic *raːwʔ. Cognate with Muong Bi rão, Tho [Cuối Chăm] riɛw⁴, Proto-Pong *riɛw⁴. This word is only attested in the more innovative subgroups (Viet-Muong, Tho, Pong), while the more conservative subgroups such as Chutic inheriting reflexes of *p-ɗoː (originally "yeast", cf. Khmu [Cuang] pdoʔ ("yeast")) or some other words.

examples.vi: ràng gói hàng sau yên xe
examples.en: to fasten a parcel to the seat of a bike

gloss: to break off; to break loose; to leave

etymology: From Proto-Vietic *k-rəŋ (“forest”). Cognate with Muong rầng, Proto-Katuic *kruuŋ, *krɨŋ (“forest”).
From Proto-Mon-Khmer *ruc ~ *ruuc ~ *ruəc (“to retreat, to withdraw”); cognate with Muong rúch and Koho ruch. Compare also Sora rɔɟ ("to pull off grain from stalks, to strip"). Related to

gloss: to pull out or pull back
to go down; to recede; to ebb

examples.vi: Sinh nhật tôi rơi vào thứ hai.

gloss: to fall (to arrive through chance, fate)

examples.vi: Số phận rơi vào tay của tổng thống.
examples.en: Fate falls into the hand of the president.

gloss: to fall to become ensnared or entrapped; to be worse off than before
